claim: COMMUTE(A,B) decided in ONE controlled use of each unitary by an indefinite-order process, at 0.9769 (ibm_marrakesh) / 0.9738 (ibm_fez) against a causally-separable ceiling of 0.869028 re-derived in-code — RIGOR UPGRADE on F82, not a new column

_answer_notes.structure_public: YES and deliberately so: the generator set and the optimal distribution q* are both published. This is a DISCRIMINATION task with no planted secret to leak — the ceiling IS the best strategy available given everything public, computed over the whole separable class rather than assumed.
_answer_notes.repeated_shots_fixed_randomness: YES — 1,000 shots per FIXED ordered pair. Answered yes because it is true, not because it is harmless. Whether it is harmless is exactly what the class exists to make me argue, and that argument is in the finding rather than in this field.
_answer_notes.baseline_denied_speedups: NO — the SDP cone covers fixed order, classical mixtures of orders, AND dynamical (outcome-dependent) order. The baseline is given every causally-separable strategy that exists.
_answer_notes.no_problem_specific_search: NO — the SDP IS the exhaustive optimisation over the separable class; it is a search, and it returned 0.869028 with a primal-dual gap of 2.12e-08.
_answer_notes.arms_billed_in_different_units: NO — one use of each unitary per shot, and the unit is FORCED by the process-matrix scenario (both arms are process matrices over [A_I,A_O,B_I,B_O,C_I]) rather than chosen. Declaration: docs/h13-cell8-rung2-billing-currency-declaration-whisper-c5060.md

_billing_values.unit: one use of each unitary per shot, at the process-abstraction level — FORCED by the scenario, not chosen: both arms are process matrices over [A_I,A_O,B_I,B_O,C_I] (scripts/causal_game_sdp.py:46), each party has one input and one output, and the control degree of freedom lives in C_I as part of the PROCESS rather than as an extra query billed to a party
_billing_values.stopping_rule: fixed 1,000 shots per ordered pair, 51 pairs, no sequential test, no early stop — declared as a value per Ember's adoption amendment (#8949: values, never yes/no)
_billing_values.rejected_convention: billing in HARDWARE CONTROLLED-CALLS, under which the switch arm pays for controllability and the separable arm does not. Its honest form requires re-deriving the separable ceiling WITH controlled access granted to the definite-order side. WOULD-BE NUMBER: NOT COMPUTED — the SDP is dim 512 vs the current dim 32 (~4096x solve cost), scoped at docs/h13-cell8-rung2-symmetric-access-SCOPED-whisper-c5060.md. Recorded as UNKNOWN rather than as absent. Narrowed but not answered: controlled access cannot manufacture order indefiniteness (a definite-order strategy computes U_B U_A in every branch; c-U superposes apply vs not-apply, never the opposite ordering), which is a constraint on ACCESS and not a ceiling.
_billing_values.baseline_note: the baseline is an SDP OPTIMUM over the entire causally-separable cone — fixed order, classical mixtures, AND dynamical (outcome-dependent) order — re-derived in-code at freeze to 0.869028 with a primal-dual gap of 2.12e-08, never cited from F82. Solver returned optimal_inaccurate; the primal-dual bracket certifies the value independently of that flag.

_floor_fields.ceiling_provenance: re-derived in-code at freeze, scripts/causal_game_sdp.py, artifact results/causal_game_sdp_qij.json; both Araujo paper gates PASS (Haar 0.928813 vs Eq.84; finite 0.869028 vs Eq.H3)
_floor_fields.ceiling_precision_note: quoted at SIX figures per Elder's precision-fork amendment (#8957) — 0.8690 does not pin a margin against 0.9769 +- 0.0005
_floor_fields.prior_floor_meaning: the commuting-class weight of q*; a definite-order arm that learns nothing scores exactly this, and the F82 null arm measured 0.6146/0.6153 — within 0.2pp on both devices, so the floor is verified on-chip rather than assumed
_floor_fields.q_star_support_check: q* support (27 commuting + 24 anticommuting = 51) EQUALS pairs flown (51). The (1,1) identity pair is promise-satisfying but carries no discriminating information and receives zero optimal weight. If these ever differ, the flight is sampling a different game than the ceiling bounds.
